integrity: Exact time-domain asymptotic limits follow from an analytic proof. Supplemental finite-time computations check identities and numerical behavior, not the infinite-time statement. The qualitative critical-boundary convergence is earlier related work and is not claimed as a new discovery. No independent scientific audit or exhaustive priority investigation has been performed.
limitations: The theorem applies to the continuous-time deterministic homogeneous public-goods dynamics with interior initial data at one of two exact feedback-reward equalities; neither stochastic games, changing reward laws, nor network effects are covered.
title: Universal critical inverse-time and logarithmic relaxation at adaptive-reward saturation
